title: Billing and Coding: Micro-Invasive Glaucoma Surgery (MIGS)

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book. The CPT codes in Group 1 are considered medically necessary when the Indications of Coverage are met. The 90-day global periods apply. Due to the laterality of eye procedures, modifiers RT, LT or 50 must be used to indicate the eye(s) being treated. See L34203 Cataract Surgery in Adults LCD and related B&C article for additional coverage indications and diagnoses.
codes.2: The CPT codes in Group 2 are considered medically necessary when the Indications of Coverage are met. The 90-day global period applies. Do not report 0671T in conjunction with 66989 or 66991.
codes.3: The following CPT codes are considered not medically reasonable and necessary (non-covered).

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. Medicare is establishing the following limited coverage for CPT codes 66989 and 66991.
covered.2: Medicare is establishing the following limited coverage for CPT code 0449T (XEN) and 0671T:

noncovered.1: Any ICD-10-CM code not listed in Group 1 "ICD-10 Codes that Support Medical Necessity" section
